topic: A neighbor wants to install a fence
text: Well, it's about time old Martin started takin' care of his side of the field. I've always kept my part neat and tidy, even though the line 'twixt our plots has been fuzzy for years. I reckoned, if the good Lord gave us clear boundaries, we ought to respect 'em. So I said to him, "By all means, Martin, if a fence will help you and your family, let's mark out the land proper and get it done." The saints know I've worked this earth long enough to see it done right. Besides, it'll make the place look proper, with our plots defined and the livestock knowing their bounds. It's a step in the right direction, and I'm glad to see it happen.
